sentences.en: There ought to be more buses during the rush hours.
sentences.zh: 在高峰时段应该有更多的公交车。

sentences.en: If your child drinks poison, rush him to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子喝了毒药，赶紧把他送到医院。

sentences.en: As Beth wiped tears from her face, she rushed home.
sentences.zh: 贝丝擦去脸上的泪水后，急忙赶回家。
